Result: --!strict
-- ForgeChecks: Studio-only live playtest runner. Executes ForgeChecksPlan and prints PASS/FAIL lines.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
if not RunService:IsStudio() then
	return
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LogService = game:GetService("LogService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Plan = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeChecksPlan", 10))
local Telemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 10))

local PREFIX = "[ForgeCheck]"
local startClock = os.clock()
local deadline = startClock + Plan.timing.maxRunSeconds

-- Output log capture (from the very start)
local logEntries: { { type: string, message: string } } = {}
LogService.MessageOut:Connect(function(message: string, messageType: Enum.MessageType)
	if string.sub(message, 1, #PREFIX) == PREFIX then
		return
	end
	if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError or messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then
		table.insert(logEntries, { type = messageType.Name, message = message })
	end
end)

local function num(v: any): number
	if type(v) == "number" then
		return v
	end
	return 0
end

local function describe(v: any): string
	if type(v) == "table" then
		local keys = {}
		for k in pairs(v) do
			table.insert(keys, tostring(k))
		end
		table.sort(keys)
		local parts = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
			table.insert(parts, k .. "=" .. tostring((v :: any)[k]))
		end
		return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}"
	end
	return tostring(v)
end

local function getCash(player: Player?): number
	if not player then
		return 0
	end
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local cash = ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Cash")
	if cash and (cash:IsA("IntValue") or cash:IsA("NumberValue")) then
		return (cash :: NumberValue).Value
	end
	return 0
end

-- Observation state
local preClaim: { [string]: number }? = nil
local dropSamples: { number } = {}
local collectedSamples: { number } = {}
local cashAtClaim = 0
local maxCash = 0
local player: Player? = nil

local function observe(): { [string]: number }
	local c = Telemetry.get()
	if preClaim == nil or num(preClaim["plot_assigned"]) == 0 then
		preClaim = c
	end
	maxCash = math.max(maxCash, getCash(player))
	return c
end

local function pause(seconds: number)
	local untilT = os.clock() + seconds
	while os.clock() < untilT and os.clock() < deadline do
		observe()
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
end

local function waitUntil(cond: () -> boolean, timeout: number): boolean
	local untilT = math.min(os.clock() + timeout, deadline)
	while os.clock() < untilT do
		observe()
		if cond() then
			return true
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	return cond()
end

local function findGate(): BasePart?
	for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(d.Name), "gate") and d.Transparency < 1 and d.CanTouch then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local claimMode: string = Plan.claimMode
if workspace:GetAttribute("ForgeCheckMode") == "gate" then
	claimMode = "gate"
end

local function claimed(): boolean
	return num(Telemetry.get()["plot_assigned"]) >= 1
end

local function run()
	-- wait for first player
	waitUntil(function()
		return #Players:GetPlayers() > 0
	end, 30)
	player = Players:GetPlayers()[1]
	if player and not player.Character then
		waitUntil(function()
			return player ~= nil and player.Character ~= nil
		end, 10)
	end

	-- wait for the build counters
	waitUntil(function()
		local c = Telemetry.get()
		return num(c["map_built"]) >= 1 and num(c["plaza_built"]) >= 1 and num(c["themes_built"]) >= 6
	end, 20)

	pause(Plan.timing.settleSeconds)
	pause(Plan.timing.preClaimWindow)

	-- claim phase
	if claimMode == "gate" then
		local untilT = os.clock() + 15
		while not claimed() and os.clock() < untilT and os.clock() < deadline do
			local gate = findGate()
			local char = player and player.Character
			if gate and char then
				char:PivotTo(gate.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
			end
			waitUntil(claimed, 3)
		end
	else
		waitUntil(claimed, Plan.timing.autoClaimSeconds + 5)
	end

	-- sampling after the claim
	local c0 = observe()
	cashAtClaim = getCash(player)
	maxCash = math.max(maxCash, cashAtClaim)
	table.insert(dropSamples, num(c0["cubes_dropped"]))
	table.insert(collectedSamples, num(c0["cubes_collected"]))
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		if os.clock() >= deadline then
			break
		end
		pause(Plan.timing.sampleInterval)
		local c = observe()
		table.insert(dropSamples, num(c["cubes_dropped"]))
		table.insert(collectedSamples, num(c["cubes_collected"]))
	end
end

local runnerError: string? = nil
local ok, err = pcall(run)
if not ok then
	runnerError = tostring(err)
end

-- Evaluate
local finalCounters = Telemetry.get()
local ctx = {
	claimMode = claimMode,
	counters = finalCounters,
	preClaim = preClaim or finalCounters,
	dropSamples = dropSamples,
	collectedSamples = collectedSamples,
	cashAtClaim = cashAtClaim,
	cashNow = maxCash,
	log = logEntries,
}

local checks: { any } = {}
for _, check in ipairs(Plan.checks) do
	table.insert(checks, check)
end
if claimMode == "gate" then
	table.insert(checks, { id = "plots_claimed", kind = "counter_gte", counter = "plots_claimed", expect = 1 })
end

local passed = 0
local failures: { { id: string, expected: string, actual: string } } = {}

for _, check in ipairs(checks) do
	local pass, message = Plan.evaluate(check, ctx)
	if pass then
		passed += 1
		Telemetry.count(Plan.counters.passed, 1)
		print(string.format("%s PASS %s", PREFIX, check.id))
	else
		local expected = describe(check.expect)
		table.insert(failures, { id = check.id, expected = expected, actual = message })
		Telemetry.count(Plan.counters.failed, 1)
		print(string.format("%s FAIL %s expected=%s actual=%s", PREFIX, check.id, expected, message))
	end
end

if runnerError then
	table.insert(failures, { id = "runner_error", expected = "no error", actual = runnerError })
	Telemetry.count(Plan.counters.failed, 1)
	print(string.format("%s FAIL runner_error expected=no error actual=%s", PREFIX, runnerError))
end

local encOk, json = pcall(function()
	return HttpService:JSONEncode({ passed = passed, failed = #failures, failures = failures })
end)
if not encOk then
	json = string.format('{"passed":%d,"failed":%d,"failures":[]}', passed, #failures)
end
print(string.format("%s RESULT %s", PREFIX, json))

workspace:SetAttribute("ForgeChecksDone", true)

-- Waits for the verify remotes (with a timeout) and exits if they never appear.
-- On request it inspects the player's own UI/world and replies with plain data.
-- It never sends gameplay intent. ForgeTelemetry is a no-op on the client, so the
-- feature_verified_* counters are bumped by the server verifier when it gets our replies.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then
	return
end

local cfgModule = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("FeatureChecksConfig", 10)
if not cfgModule then
	return
end
local Config = require(cfgModule)

local remotesFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(Config.Remotes.Folder, 10)
if not remotesFolder then
	return
end
local Req = remotesFolder:WaitForChild(Config.Remotes.Request, 10)
local Res = remotesFolder:WaitForChild(Config.Remotes.Response, 10)
if not Req or not Res or not Req:IsA("RemoteEvent") or not Res:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
	return
end

local Gui = Config.Gui

local function getPlayerGui(): Instance?
	return player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
end

-- True if the instance (and every GUI ancestor) is actually shown.
local function isShown(inst: Instance?): boolean
	if not inst then
		return false
	end
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		return inst.Transparency < 0.99
	end
	local cur: Instance? = inst
	while cur do
		if cur:IsA("GuiObject") and not cur.Visible then
			return false
		end
		if cur:IsA("ScreenGui") and not cur.Enabled then
			return false
		end
		if cur:IsA("BillboardGui") and not cur.Enabled then
			return false
		end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return true
end

local function findShopButton(): GuiButton?
	local pg = getPlayerGui()
	if not pg then
		return nil
	end
	local byName = pg:FindFirstChild(Gui.ShopButton, true)
	if byName and byName:IsA("GuiButton") then
		return byName
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("TextButton") and string.find(string.upper(d.Text), "SHOP", 1, true) then
			return d
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function collectCards(): ({ any }, boolean)
	local list = {}
	local anyShown = false
	local pg = getPlayerGui()
	if not pg then
		return list, false
	end
	for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
		local id = d:GetAttribute(Gui.ShopCardAttrUpgradeId)
		if id ~= nil then
			local priceText = ""
			local attrPrice = d:GetAttribute(Gui.ShopCardAttrPrice)
			if d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextLabel") then
				priceText = d.Text
			end
			for _, c in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
				if (c:IsA("TextLabel") or c:IsA("TextButton")) and string.find(c.Text, "$", 1, true) then
					priceText = c.Text
					break
				end
			end
			local shown = isShown(d)
			anyShown = anyShown or shown
			table.insert(list, {
				UpgradeId = tostring(id),
				PriceText = priceText,
				Price = type(attrPrice) == "number" and attrPrice or nil,
				Affordable = d:GetAttribute(Gui.ShopCardAttrAffordable) == true,
				Visible = shown,
			})
		end
	end
	return list, anyShown
end

local function shopPanelVisible(): boolean
	local pg = getPlayerGui()
